# Model generator fixtures

## Generated event-set frames

`event_set_frames.json` was captured on 2026-09-07 before adding explicit
`NoritoSchema` declarations to the `EventSet` generator. It contains all 25
production set types: 13 direct derive callers and 12 generated by `data_event!`.
For each type, the empty set, first declared event and full set retain their
JSON value and complete root, `Vec` and `Option` Norito frames: 75 values and
225 frames in total.

The fixture SHA-256 is
`547236d002ee130e046bab37bb735b280c5c09f08797afa219716ecb9cde137e`.
The nominal names and both directional schema hashes also match the controlled
model capture described in [the schema identity specification](../../../../specs/norito_schema_identity.md),
whose report SHA-256 is
`be82d3661d9e2a79fd1a60d6922f1387d3821a0ad5a65d80d294aca1251caedd`.
The frame capture is a local working-tree checkpoint, not sealed release
qualification or proof of other feature/target combinations.

The temporary capture writer was removed. The permanent
`production_event_sets_preserve_captured_frames` test only reads this fixture,
compares every byte and JSON value, and roundtrips every frame. The enclosing
data-event enums have a separate 12-type captured-identity test.
